subject: MAP: decision ladder & technical gating for marketplace private offer
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@aperturelabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: decision ladder & technical gating for marketplace private offer

Anna — great speaking yesterday. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that splits the next 6 weeks into a decision ladder and technical gating checklist so your infra and procurement teams have clear owners and dates. High level: 

- Week 1 (this week): sandbox access, sample tokens, and security questionnaire answers
- Week 2: technical acceptance tests (perf at 95th pct, KV cache sanity, inference latency)
- Weeks 3–4: procurement paperwork (PO template review, billing path alignment)
- Week 5: private offer sign and DocuSign routing
- Week 6: staged activation and billing smoke test

Two asks from your side to make the schedule real: the name and email for the procurement lead (for PO routing) and a point person from infra who can run the perf tests on your test dataset. If you want, Karthik can run the perf script with your infra on a short call.

I've attached MPA_Aperture_v1_20250618.pdf and a short SOC2 summary for your security team.

Best,
Soojin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MPA_Aperture_v1_20250618.pdf (PDF, 3 pages); SOC2-Summary-Redwood.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@aperturelabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aperturelabs.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: decision ladder & technical gating for marketplace private offer

Thanks Soojin — this looks helpful and nicely granular. Quick notes from procurement: we need the PO template and the anticipated billing flow (monthly invoice vs marketplace billing) spelled out for our finance team. Procurement lead is Diego Ramos (diego.ramos@aperturelabs.com).

On the infra side, I'll loop in Diego this morning and ask for someone to own the perf window. Can we schedule a 30-minute run-through with Karthik next Tuesday (6/24) morning PT? If Karthik can share the perf script and expected resource footprint ahead of time, that will speed validation.

— Anna
VP Product, Aperture Labs

Quoted reply: "On Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700 Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote: > Anna — great speaking yesterday..."

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@aperturelabs.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: decision ladder & technical gating for marketplace private offer

Anna — thanks for the heads up and Diego's contact. I can do Tue 24 Jun 09:30 PT for a 30-minute perf run. I'll drop the perf script, expected sample sizes, and a checklist in the Drive folder ahead of the call (link in thread metadata). For the perf run we'll validate: 

- 95th percentile latency at your target concurrency (you mentioned 40 concurrent sessions)
- KV cache behavior for multi-turn flows (we'll replay a 100-session trace)
- Token costs estimate for your expected monthly volume

Regarding billing: Soojin, recommend we give them two clear options in the MPA: (A) marketplace private offer billing (monthly invoicing through AWS marketplace with NET30) or (B) direct Redwood invoicing tied to a Reserved Dedicated plan. Include pros/cons and the PO template for (A).

I'll prepare the perf checklist before Tuesday and share the runbook.

— Karthik
Sr Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: perf_runbook_v0.2.sh (BASH script)

From: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@aperturelabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@aperturelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: decision ladder & technical gating for marketplace private offer

Thanks all — I ran the quick perf with Karthik this morning. Notes:

- 95th pct latency at target concurrency (40) is 220ms on our baseline instance; acceptable but we'll need a small burst buffer for peak traffic.
- KV cache replay surfaced a minor alignment bug around session IDs that we will patch on our side.
- Billing preference: we prefer marketplace private offer (option A) to keep billing consolidated in our ledger.

Next steps we need from Redwood: final PO template with Redwood billing/legal details and confirmation of invoice cadence (monthly, NET30). Can you also include the private-offer SKU id so our marketplace team can preseed the vendor mapping?

Anna, forwarding to procurement thread for signature routing.

Thanks,
Diego Ramos
Head of Procurement, Aperture Labs
